players.product: heat pipes, vapor chambers, thermal modules and server / rack-level liquid-cooling systems

quarterly_data.signal: 1H 2026 results (through June 2026): net sales NT$4,678 million (Q1 2026 NT$2,221 million), gross profit margin 17%, net profit margin -3%, EPS NT$-1.82. FY2025: net sales NT$9,094 million, gross margin 15%, net margin -2%, EPS NT$-2.44.
quarterly_data.figure: 1H 2026 net sales NT$4,678 million; gross margin 17%; net margin -3%; EPS -1.82

quarterly_data.signal: Liquid-cooling manufacturing: cold plate development at Kunshan, China (Phase 1) has entered mass production; Hanoi, Vietnam (Phase 2) is to replicate Kunshan's capabilities and localize production of key components; the parent company's Thailand operations are leveraged for end-to-end vertical integration of liquid cooling products. Vietnam site roadmap (2026-2028): mass production of key heat pipe / vapor chamber components in Vietnam, fan production lines with strategic partners, and full deployment of liquid cooling module production lines. The company frames the shift to liquid cooling as AI chip power rises rapidly from 350W to 3,500W+.
quarterly_data.figure: Kunshan cold plates in mass production; Vietnam roadmap 2026-2028; AI chip power 350W to 3,500W+

quarterly_data.signal: Product roadmap: high-wattage air / liquid cooling tiers - D8 heat pipe module 300~500 Watts, HP/VC module 500~800 Watts, high-power HP/VC module 800~1300 Watts, LCM/CDM 3000~7000 Watts. Liquid cooling line-up: CPU & GPU liquid cooling modules (LCM), ASIC & PCIe LCM, server / rack / row / custom manifolds and a mini CDU with 8kW and 30kW cooling capacity. Server air cooling (current to future): AI server CPU VC + heat pipe 300W to 600W; cloud server CPU heat pipe 1000W to 1400W (two CPUs); switch remote VC + heat pipe 850W to 1300W; network card VC 200G (25W) to 400G (60W).
quarterly_data.figure: LCM/CDM 3000~7000 Watts; mini CDU 8kW / 30kW; AI server CPU 300W to 600W

quarterly_data.signal: Business strategy (company): expand the AI and liquid cooling business by establishing a dedicated liquid cooling development organization for server applications and strengthening sales-R&D collaboration to accelerate penetration into major cloud service providers; strengthen the manufacturing base by increasing in-house production and consolidating key component production, fixed-cost optimization and group-wide integration. Outlook: maintain stable supply for PCs, servers, networking equipment and portable devices, and focus on advanced thermal solutions for humanoid robots, robotic arms and industrial automation equipment.
